why: The book's own expression is right and its printed RESULT drops a factor of 10^-3. (72.35 x pi)/(180 x 2pi x 50) = 72.35/18000 = 4.019e-3 s. Self-refuting: at 50 Hz the period is 0.02 s, so a 4.019 s lag would be 201 complete cycles.

The book divides by R where the impedance Z belongs: i_rms = e_rms/Z, not e_rms/R. With Z = 5 ohm the average power is 4805 W; the printed 8008.9 W is exactly Z/R = 5/3 times too large, which is what identifies the mechanism.
